zh.title: 漢莎航空技術與阿聯酋航空延長A380維修合約
zh.summary: 漢莎技術與阿聯酋航空延長A380維修合約至2030年
body: 漢莎航空技術（Lufthansa Technik）與阿聯酋航空（Emirates）宣布延長基地維修服務合約，以支援該航空公司在亞洲的空中巴士A380機隊。
雙方於2026年9月2日表示，位於馬尼拉的漢莎航空技術菲律賓公司將繼續為阿聯酋航空的A380進行重檢（heavy checks），直至2030年。
漢莎技術表示，這項新協議是其菲律賓據點歷史上價值最高的協議之一。
阿聯酋航空也將成為漢莎技術菲律賓位於克拉克國際機場（MNL）新廠房的啟動客戶，該廠房亦將支援空中巴士A350與波音787。

en.title: Lufthansa Technik, Emirates extend A380 base maintenance contract through 2030
en.summary: Lufthansa Technik extends Emirates A380 base maintenance contract through 2030; Emirates to be launch customer at Clark facility.
body: Lufthansa Technik and Emirates have extended their base maintenance services contract to support Emirates' fleet of Airbus A380 aircraft in Asia. On September 2, 2026, the two organizations said that Lufthansa Technik Philippines will continue to perform heavy checks on Emirates' A380 aircraft through 2030.

At the Lufthansa Technik Philippines facility in Manila, the MRO company provides two dedicated base maintenance lines to Emirates, the world's largest A380 operator. According to Lufthansa Technik, the new agreement is one of the largest by value in the history of its Philippines facility.

Emirates will also become the launch customer for Lufthansa Technik Philippines' new facility at Clark International Airport (MNL) once operations begin. The new facility at Clark International Airport will support Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 aircraft.

zh.title: 德軍核准Rheinmetall LUNA NG無人機訓練飛行
zh.summary: 德軍航太局核准LUNA NG臨時適航認證；允許訓練與測試飛行
body: 德國軍用航空當局已授予Rheinmetall LUNA NG無人偵察系統臨時適航認證。根據AeroTime報導，這份由德國聯邦國防軍航空局（Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr，LufABw）發出的證書，是邁向完整型別認證的中繼步驟。Rheinmetall表示，完整核准所需的標準大部分已達成，但未說明尚有哪些項目待補。
此臨時證書允許德國軍方以該系統自行進行訓練與測試飛行作業。Rheinmetall並表示，首批德國軍方飛行員與驗證員已完成該機型的相關訓練。
在取得軍方核准前，LUNA NG以民用飛行執照執行了約150架次的飛行作業，總計約200飛行小時。根據Rheinmetall的說明，認證作業係依照與空中巴士A320等大型飛機相同的標準進行；包括自動駕駛與導航系統在內的安全關鍵零組件，因戰術無人機無現成等效產品，必須由公司自行開發並完成認證。
Rheinmetall指出，此核准使LUNA NG得以在符合民用安全標準下，納入「正常受限空域」運作，不再僅限於軍事區域；若能符合航空測試規範，最終或可於歐洲人口稠密地區的民眾領空進行常態性作業。
德國軍方以HUSAR為代號導入LUNA NG。Rheinmetall在原始製造商EMT破產後接手該計劃；2023年9月28日簽署的合約修訂案涵蓋12套量產系統與1套先導系統，總價約2億歐元（約2.31億美元）。Rheinmetall未在其認證消息中提出更新的交運時程。

en.title: Rheinmetall LUNA NG drone gets provisional Bundeswehr airworthiness approval
en.summary: German military aviation authority grants LUNA NG provisional certification; enables Bundeswehr training and test flights
body: Germany's military aviation authority has granted provisional airworthiness certification to the Rheinmetall LUNA NG unmanned reconnaissance system. The certificate from the Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr (LufABw) is an interim step toward full type certification, which Rheinmetall said remains in progress. The company said the majority of the criteria required for full approval have been met, without specifying which remain outstanding.

The provisional certificate allows the Bundeswehr to conduct its own flight operations with the system for training and testing. Rheinmetall said the first German military pilots and verifiers had completed training on the type.

Before receiving military approval, the system completed roughly 150 sorties totaling approximately 200 flight hours under civil operating licenses, according to Rheinmetall. Mike Schmidt, CEO of Rheinmetall's Air Unmanned Space business unit, said certification was conducted to the same standards applied to large aircraft such as the Airbus A320. Safety-critical components, including the autopilot and navigation systems, had to be developed and certified in-house because no certified equivalents were available for tactical unmanned aircraft, he added.

Rheinmetall said the approval allows LUNA NG to be integrated into regular, restricted airspace while meeting civil safety standards, removing its confinement to purely military areas. Compliance with aviation testing procedures could ultimately permit regular operations over densely populated European territory, according to the company.

The Bundeswehr is introducing LUNA NG under the designation HUSAR. Rheinmetall took over the program from the original manufacturer, EMT, after the company became insolvent. A contract amendment signed on September 28, 2023, covered 12 production systems and one pilot system, with a total value of approximately €200 million ($231 million).
